description.en: A shared shopping list, grouped by aisle.
description.zh: 按货架分组的共享购物清单。

instructions: One row per thing to buy: name (1 to 80 characters), aisle (one of the space's aisles, the setting 'aisles', or empty for other) and done (true once ticked). Adding a name that is on the list already, ignoring case, spaces and full-width letters, marks that row as needed again (done: false) instead of adding a second one.

help.en: Items are grouped in this order.
